mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) increases risk of primaquine-related cardiotoxicity and hemolytic toxicity; both drugs have independent cardiac and hematologic effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes closely, maintain potassium and magnesium levels in normal range, and assess baseline G6PD status before primaquine initiation; consider ECG monitoring given additive cardiac risks.
